title: In accordance with the provisions of G.L. c. 25, § 17, 17A and 18 of the General Laws and Chapter 60 of the Acts of 1994 the Department of Public Utilities hereby makes an assessment on the Intra-State Revenues of gas, electric and telephone companies in the estimated amount of 43,864,773 for FY 1996 (plus adjustments for the FY 1994 estimate).
